text:
Line 3 of `catalog/members.py`:

> `# The lending policy allows each member to hold five books at once.`

All 16 tests now pass with `python3 -m unittest`. The first run showed 15 because `test_search` couldn't be imported and was counted as a single error. Its two tests run now. I only changed code in `catalog/` and left the tests as they were.

- **`catalog/members.py:4`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, which contradicted the policy comment on line 3. I set it to 5.
- **`catalog/books.py:22`**: `parse_book` kept the year as a string, which also broke `age()`. It now uses `int(year)`.
- **`catalog/factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`, which its own docstring lists. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`catalog/fees.py:14`**: The late fee added `DAILY_FEE` to the number of days instead of multiplying by it. It's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`catalog/inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, so it returned one event too many. It now uses `[-n:]` and returns `[]` when `n <= 0`, because `[-0:]` would otherwise return the whole history.
- **`catalog/search.py:3`**: It imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
